steps.title: Model call 1 for candid management: 2,571 tokens in, 177 out, ~$0.0009 at paid rates
details: The model decided to submit its finding: insufficient evidence, citing passage 1A:72 sentence 1; passage 1A:70 sentence 7.

Its rationale: The filing acknowledges that the company's earnings could decline if management makes incorrect strategic choices or fails to execute effectively, and it notes the possibility of material weaknesses in internal controls. steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 2 problems in 7 items
details: The Critic objected to the understandable business verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The quotes describe products and customers but do not explicitly state how revenue is earned (e.g., fees or interest). The rationale mentions segments not in the quotes.
The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "2025", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 2 findings back for repair
details: Understandable business: constrained retry (the agent must cite something new or lower its verdict).
Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).
